queue.title: Streak verification (verify first, fix only if wrong)
queue.notes: Root-caused and fixed Oct 18 'Streak 0 while reading daily' server bug in functions/lib/points.mjs (forgehouse50 commit 04d9fb4, CI 41176970742 green): (1) streaks() previously checked highestCompleted < elapsedDays(today), which falsely reset every active daily reader's current streak to 0 at 00:00 WAT on every scheduled reading day before they completed today's reading; changed inactivity check to strictly past uncompleted reading days (r.date < today) so active streaks remain alive throughout today and grow +1 upon on-time completion (verified live on consistency leaderboard: active daily readers now show current=12, 6, 2 instead of 0 on Saturday morning, while Section 5 screenshot user with 7/50 on Day 13 correctly remains 0). (2) Fixed longest streak calculation so catch-up days (compDate > sched) never add to longest or current streak. (3) Added Cache-Control: no-store + deterministic NOW_MS support on /api/progress and /api/auth/me, plus 6-scenario SQLite D1 suite in test/streak_test.mjs.
